subject: Security intake + IR timeline & BCP artifacts for NanoMedi POC
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Price <liam.price@nanomedicorp.com>, security@nanomedicorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: security intake & what we need from NanoMedi (SOC2 / IR / BCP)

Hi Liam — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap from our side and the security artifacts we'll start collecting to keep the POC moving: 

What Redwood can provide (initial):
- SOC 2 status: we currently maintain SOC 2 Type I (controls audit completed 2024) and have a Type II engagement underway; expected completion: Q3 2025. I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary for the intake.
- IR / breach notification playbook excerpt (attached): includes notification windows and escalation contacts.
- BCP/DR matrix showing RTO/RPO targets per service (CSV attached).

What we need from you to complete intake:
1) Completed vendor security questionnaire (we can accept your PDF or we can push a portal link).
2) Confirm your preferred breach notification recipients and SLA (e.g., legal, security, product).
3) Any specific regulatory constraints (HIPAA data flow questions, GDPR/Data Processing Addendum items).

Ask / next steps:
- Can you share the completed questionnaire or tell us whether you prefer a portal upload by EOD Monday 2025-06-09?
- Would a short triage call with Olga (our security engineer) on Fri 6/6 at 10:00 PT work to walk the checklist?

Attachments: POC_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (POC timeline), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary), redwood_ir_runbook_excerpt.txt (excerpt), redwood_bc_dr_matrix.csv (RTO/RPO matrix)

If you want redactions on the SOC 2 summary we can provide a redacted extract for initial review — let me know which sections you need omitted.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal owners once I hear back.

—
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Liam Price <liam.price@nanomedicorp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@nanomedicorp.com
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security intake & what we need from NanoMedi (SOC2 / IR / BCP)

Mina — thanks, that was a helpful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side before we upload anything: 

1) Backups: Are daily backups encrypted at rest and do you use customer-managed keys (CMK/KMS)?
2) Notification recipients: Our legal team requires an initial notification to legal@nanomedicorp.com and security@nanomedicorp.com within your stated SLA. Can you confirm the primary Redwood contact for notifications?
3) Evidence delivery: We prefer a secure upload via SFTP or a pre-signed link rather than email attachments for anything considered sensitive.

I've attached our vendor questionnaire as a PDF for your team to review. We can aim to get the completed questionnaire to you by Mon 6/9, but that depends on any follow-up clarifications.

Also: can you confirm retention windows for audit logs and IDS alerts? We have a few compliance checks that look specifically for >=90 days of IDS telemetry.

Thanks —
Liam

Attachments: NanoMedi_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Price <liam.price@nanomedicorp.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security intake & what we need from NanoMedi (SOC2 / IR / BCP)

Liam — appreciate the quick questions. We’ll start the evidence collection this week. Mina and I will own coordination; Olga will triage technical questions and run through your questionnaire responses.

Preliminary answers (we’ll follow up with Olga for technical details and the secure upload link):
- Backups: yes, all backups are encrypted at rest. We use AWS KMS with customer-key options for enterprise/private deployments; hosted customers have managed keys.
- Primary notification contact at Redwood: security@redwood.ai is the operational channel; for POC escalation you will get Mina (AM), Ben (Sales) and Olga (Security) in the loop.
- Retention: audit logs (API and admin) are retained for 2 years; IDS/telemetry can be retained for 90 days in our hosted offering and longer in Dedicated/Private configs.

We’ll produce a checklist for the items you’ll need to upload and provide a presigned upload link (S3) to avoid emailing artifacts. Olga — can you take point on the questionnaire review and confirm what exact telemetry extracts we can supply for the 90-day IDS request?

On Fri 6/6 at 10:00 PT Mina suggested a 30-min triage; we’ll send a calendar invite if that works for you.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security intake & what we need from NanoMedi (SOC2 / IR / BCP)

Hi Liam — Olga from Redwood security here; thanks for the questionnaire and the clear asks. I’ll run through the checklist and confirm what we can provide for the POC. High-level answers and next steps below.

Answers to your questions:
- Backups: All production backups are encrypted at rest (AES-256). For our hosted service we manage keys with AWS KMS; we support BYOK/CMK for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Notification recipients: For any incident meeting our notificaton threshold we follow this path: initial internal detection -> internal security triage (within 4 hours) -> initial customer notification (72 hours for confirmed incidents that meet the legal/regulatory thresholds). Notifications go to security@nanomedicorp.com and legal@nanomedicorp.com by default when you provide them. We can add product@ or ops@ if required.
- Retention windows: Audit logs (admin/API) = 2 years; IDS/telemetry = 90 days (hosted). If you need longer retention we can propose a Dedicated/Private configuration.

What we can upload now (redwood artifacts):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type I summary (attached) and SOC 2 Type II readiness statement (Type II final expected Q3 2025)
- IR runbook excerpt (includes escalation contacts and notification templates)
- BCP/DR matrix and recovery target commitments per service
- Evidence checklist for items you requested (attached)

Secure upload: we will provision a pre-signed S3 upload link and send it to the security contact you provide. Please upload the completed questionnaire and any related evidence to that link rather than emailing attachments.

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 6/6 10:00 PT: triage call to walk the checklist (30 min) — we’ll send invite.
- Mon 6/9 EOD: target for NanoMedi to upload completed questionnaire and requested items. If you need an extension, let us know and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: evidence_request_checklist.md (checklist)

If you have specific legal/regulatory language for breach notification windows (e.g., HIPAA-required notification flows), share it and we’ll map how our procedures align.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
